title: Infinitely many holes in connectedness loci for collinear affine iterated function systems
summary: We investigate the topology of connectedness loci, denoted as $M_n$, for a one-parameter family of collinear affine iterated function systems featuring equally spaced translations. These loci are arithmetically equivalent to the closures of roots of monic polynomials whose non-leading coefficients fall within a prescribed finite interval of integers. Our main theorem proves that for every integer $n \ge 2$, the connectedness locus $M_n$ contains infinitely many holes.
